summary: Verified the Installation assignment pool bug fix end-to-end. Backend GET /api/users/team/INSTALLATION now returns both INSTALLATION and INSTALLATION_MEMBER active users (8 active INSTALLATION_MEMBER users returned; 0 active INSTALLATION-role users exist, 31 inactive INSTALLATION users correctly excluded). GET /api/users/team/REGISTRATION returns only 1 REGISTRATION user; /api/users/team/ACCOUNTS returns only 1 ACCOUNTS user — no cross-role leakage. Frontend: logged in as instmgr, opened INSTALLATION-stage AWAITING_ASSIGNMENT ECP (b2d60ebb-8e65-4e8f-b157-43c91a0ad8cd), clicked assign-install-button, dropdown listed all 8 INSTALLATION_MEMBER users including 'Manish Install-Member' (instmem). Selected instmem and submitted; ECP transitioned to READY_TO_INSTALL with responsible person 'Manish Install-Member'. Toast 'Installation assigned' shown. No console errors (only benign radix DialogContent aria-describedby warnings).

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby / Description (accessibility warning, pre-existing, not part of this bugfix)

critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and correct: role_q = {'$in': list(wf.INSTALL_MEMBER_ROLES)} if role == 'INSTALLATION' else role preserves exact-role behavior for other teams.

Note: 31 inactive INSTALLATION-role users exist in DB (legacy). The active filter correctly excludes them. Consider a data migration to convert active users' legacy INSTALLATION role to INSTALLATION_MEMBER if any exist in future.
Non-blocking a11y: All shadcn Dialogs on the site (assign, closure, etc.) miss DialogDescription — pre-existing.
test_credentials: instmgr / InstMgr@123 (INSTALLATION_MANAGER); instmem / InstMem@123 (INSTALLATION_MEMBER); Owner: anoopdube07@gmail.com / Owner@123
seed_data_creation: None — used existing ECP b2d60ebb-8e65-4e8f-b157-43c91a0ad8cd (INSTALLATION / AWAITING_ASSIGNMENT). Note: after this test that ECP is now assigned to Manish Install-Member (state changed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Installation pool bug is fully resolved. The tested ECP b2d60ebb-... is now in READY_TO_INSTALL. If another AWAITING_ASSIGNMENT ECP is needed, use OWNER GET /api/ecps and filter by current_stage=='INSTALLATION' and install_status=='AWAITING_ASSIGNMENT' (field is current_stage, not stage).
rca of the issue: Previous code used exact match {'role': 'INSTALLATION'} which returned 0 users because the seed/DB uses INSTALLATION_MEMBER for the worker pool (8 active). Fix expands the query using wf.INSTALL_MEMBER_ROLES = {INSTALLATION, INSTALLATION_MEMBER} only when role == 'INSTALLATION'. Verified via API (both roles included; other roles unaffected) and via UI (dropdown populated, assignment succeeded, stage advanced).
